description: This Java class determines the character set (charset) from a content-type string, falling back to UTF-8 if no charset is specified or if the specified charset is unsupported.

classes.name: CharsetDeterminer
classes.description: Singleton class that determines the charset from a content-type string, implementing the Function interface to provide the charset based on input content-type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of CharsetDeterminer.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Determines the charset from a content-type string, defaulting to UTF-8 if none is specified or if the specified charset is unsupported.
